error.load: This file cannot be read. Choose an image (PNG, JPG) or a PDF.

problem.scale: Enter a value for all four calibration lines; the two lines of an axis must not have the same value.
problem.ground: Enter the ground level in m NAP; the axis of the scan is in NAP.
problem.trace: There is no line yet. Choose ‘Follow line’ and click the start of the measured line, or draw it by hand.
problem.name: Give the CPT a name.
problem.duplicate: The project already contains a CPT with this name.

meta.originValue: Traced from a scan ({{file}}); cone resistance only

hint.calibrate: Drag the four dashed lines onto grid lines whose value you know and enter those values on the right. The lines snap to the grid.
hint.follow: Click the start of the measured line: it is followed downwards until it ends. Drag downwards to follow it only as far as the point of release.
hint.draw: Hold the mouse button down and draw over the measured line. What you draw replaces the line at that level.
hint.erase: Drag over the part of the line that has to go.
hint.start: Choose a scan of a CPT chart: an image or a page from a PDF.

line.showMask: Show what the algorithm sees as line

cpt.name: Name
cpt.summary: {{count}} data points from {{from}} to {{to}} m below ground level, maximum cone resistance {{max}} MPa.
cpt.note: A traced CPT has a cone resistance only. Check the line against the scan: the accuracy is that of the paper.
